## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0: B slow 0.50-10.0 T, 165 rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) 0.0125 /T, dB cap 0.25 T -> df 0.53 T, F\_Nyq 39 T); (Vtg,Vbg) co-swept fast along D=0, n -1.26..+3.24e12, 101 pts (dn 0.045e12); sr1 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS, fast\_delay 0.7 s, slow\_delay 2.0 s; ends at 10 T, gates 0 V · **ETA ~11:38** (≈6h10m)

**Why this, now (plan step 4).** The spot checks (runs 6/7) proved the device
can carry the measurement — SdH onset at or below 0.3 T, peak R ≤ 590 Ω, flat
leakage, T = 1.243 ± 0.032 K — but they **cannot settle the stacking**. On the
electron side (n = +3.2×10¹², F_Onsager = 33.1 T) run 6 shows a 7.1 T tone with
content at 14.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T, and a single 33.3 T peak dominating the B > 4 T
window. A real second Fermi surface (the ABAB model's heavy band, 25.6 T) and the
3rd harmonic of 7.1 T (21.3 T) are 4.3 T apart — the spot check's frequency
resolution at its usable low edge cannot separate them, and one trace at one
density cannot tell a *band* from a *harmonic* at all. The discriminator is
**F(n): how many SdH branches there are and what fraction of the density each
carries**, tracked across both carrier signs. ABAB → two branches, f₁ + f₂ = 1.
ABCA → one branch at the full Onsager slope h/4e. ABCB → two, strongly e/h
asymmetric. Branch *fractions* are scale-free, so this read survives the fact
that our density scale is still a 9.5 nm geometry prior (only c_bg/c_tg = 0.773
is calibrated from data).

**Design.** B slow (the magnet blocks and is rate-limited — it can only be the
slow axis), (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept fast along region A's D = 0 line. The B grid is
**uniform in 1/B**, which is what `sdh_fft` wants and what makes every column an
even record: 165 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0125 T⁻¹ → **F_Nyquist = 39 T** (above the
33.5 T full-density Onsager frequency at the top of the window), with ΔB capped
at 0.25 T so the 4–10 T end keeps 25 rows for a by-eye fan rather than the ~9 a
pure 1/B grid would leave. Frequency resolution is set by the **low** edge, not
the high one: B_lo = 0.5 T gives **df = 0.53 T**, i.e. 21.3 T and 25.6 T are
separated by 8 resolution elements. That is the whole reason the low-B rows are
worth half the run. Fast axis: 101 points, n = −1.26 → +3.235×10¹², Δn =
0.045×10¹² — 5.4 points per filling factor at 10 T, and ≥ 5 mV of margin at both
TG validator ends.

**Two regions, one pair.** Run 5 found **two CNP ridges** — A (slope −0.773) and
B (slope −0.691), offset by n_B ≈ −0.43×10¹² in region-A units — in series on
the only wired Rxx pair (sr1 = B_1–B_2). The fast window straddles both, so this
fan should contain **two fan origins**, at n = 0 and n ≈ −0.43×10¹². Separating
them is how this session delivers the brief's *region-resolved* verdict; if the
two fans differ in branch structure, that is the headline, not a nuisance.

**Preconditions to eyeball before it runs.** T_sample 1.0–1.5 K; B within 50 mT
of 0 (the handoff park); V_si = 0; both gates at 0 V; gate-current NPLC back at
1; PS heater on and output enabled. All printed expected-vs-actual and asserted.
Sensitivity is fixed at **200 µV = 20 kΩ full scale** for the whole map — 34×
the highest R seen so far, sized for the ν = 0 peak at the CNP columns growing
with B (session-notes recipe fix: size to the map's worst corner, not the 1D
peak), not to the ≈ 70–590 Ω away from it.

**Checkpoints (`hera-watch`, armed before launch).** (1) *First rows* — signal
present and not railed at 200 µV, point noise comparable to the ~23 nV of runs
6/7, leakage flat, CNP peak where the run-5 calibration puts it. If the 4× range
step scaled the noise with full scale and killed the low-B contrast, abort there
and re-run at 50 µV; if the CNP columns rail below ~3 T, abort and re-run at
500 µV. (2) *≈ 3 h 25 m in*, at B = 2 T with 120 of 165 rows landed — the 0.5–2 T
block alone gives df ≈ 0.6 T, enough for a first F(n) branch extraction. That is
the go/abandon call: no resolvable fan structure there and the fan is not the
right instrument at this electron temperature, and I fall back to the CNP-vs-D
gap measurement (plan 6a) on the way down. (3) B ≈ 4 T and on completion.

**Coverage trade, stated.** D = 0 only — no finite-D fan this run, which means
the D-induced gap (the secondary ABCA discriminator) stays where run 5 left it;
a second fan at finite D would cost another ~6 h and is deliberately deferred to
after the branch read. The hole side reaches only n = −1.26×10¹², set by the
−0.3 V top-gate limit, against +3.24×10¹² on the electron side, so an e/h
asymmetry read is range-limited on the hole side — worth remembering if the call
comes down to ABCB. Direction: ascending from the park, ending at **10 T** with
the gates returned to 0 V, so the next step (plan 6a, CNP vs D) rides the magnet
back down instead of re-traversing.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`) at D = 0: B slow 0.5 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B, (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept fast along D = 0 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- fast axis: (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept along D = 0; n spans the full window the validators allow on that line,
#     backed off so both TG ends keep >= 5 mV of margin.
N_FAST = 101
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.260, 3.235, N_FAST)                 # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.0450e12
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec),
                                      CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_rt, _D_rt = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(_D_rt).max() < 1e-9, np.abs(_D_rt).max()     # the fast line really is D = 0
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({N_FAST} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12) at D = 0; "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f} .. {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V (margin {Vtg_vec.min()-TG_MIN:+.4f} / {TG_MAX-Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}), "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f} .. {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V (margin {Vbg_vec.min()-BG_MIN:+.4f} / {BG_MAX-Vbg_vec.max():+.4f})")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B (SdH is periodic in 1/B -> hands sdh_fft an already-even record, no resample),
#     with dB capped so the high-field end stays dense enough to read fan lines by eye.
def _invB_grid(b_lo, b_hi, d_invB, db_max):
    out, b = [b_hi], b_hi
    while b > b_lo:
        nb = 1.0 / (1.0 / b + d_invB)
        if b - nb > db_max:
            nb = b - db_max
        b = nb
        out.append(b)
    return np.round(np.array(sorted(x for x in out if x >= b_lo - 1e-9)), 4)

B_LO, B_HI, D_INVB, DB_MAX = 0.5, 10.0, 0.0125, 0.25
B_vec = _invB_grid(B_LO, B_HI, D_INVB, DB_MAX)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
_df = 1.0 / (1.0 / B_vec[0] - 1.0 / B_vec[-1])
_fnyq = 0.5 / np.abs(np.diff(1.0 / B_vec)).max()
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} B rows {B_vec[0]:.4f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T, uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) = {D_INVB} /T, dB cap {DB_MAX} T); "
      f"FFT df = {_df:.2f} T, F_Nyquist = {_fnyq:.0f} T; rows <1 T: {(B_vec<1).sum()}, 1-2 T: {((B_vec>=1)&(B_vec<2)).sum()}, "
      f"2-4 T: {((B_vec>=2)&(B_vec<4)).sum()}, >=4 T: {(B_vec>=4).sum()}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: the handoff park), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), V_tg = {k_tg.volt():+.4f} V / V_bg = {k_bg.volt():+.4f} V (0 / 0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, "
      f"output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 0.7, 2.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Runs 6/7 peaked at
# 590 Ohm away from the CNP; this map crosses the CNP on every row and the nu = 0 peak grows with B, so size to
# ~34x the highest R measured so far (session-notes recipe fix: size to the map's worst corner, not the 1D peak).
# Point noise at 50 uV was ~23 nV and is input-referred, so the 4x range step costs little SNR - verified at the
# first-rows checkpoint.
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V / {meas_config['bias_resistor']:.0e} Ohm; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V "
      f"({sr1.sensitivity()/1e-8:.0f} Ohm FS at 10 nA), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan at D = 0: B slow {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.1f} T uniform in 1/B ({len(B_vec)} rows), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) co-swept fast along D = 0, n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({N_FAST} pts), "
                  f"Vsi = 0, sr1 200 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line, run-5 cal (ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f} from data, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2 geometry prior, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12, {N_FAST} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12, '
              f'Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]:.4f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) {D_INVB} /T, dB cap {DB_MAX} T), '
              f'FFT df {_df:.2f} T, F_Nyquist {_fnyq:.0f} T; sr1 200 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; '
              f'expect two fan origins (region A at n = 0, region B at n ~ -0.43e12)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (left where the fan ended - the next step rides it down), "
          f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")
